WITH
    (
        SELECT max(DateKey)
        FROM
        (
            SELECT DateKey FROM retail.FactSales
            UNION ALL
            SELECT DateKey FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
        )
    ) AS max_date,
    toStartOfQuarter(max_date) AS current_quarter_start,
    addQuarters(current_quarter_start, -1) AS last_quarter_start
SELECT
    ifNull(p.BrandName, 'Unknown') AS brand_name,
    round(
        sum(sales_amount - return_amount - discount_amount - total_cost),
        2
    ) AS profit
FROM
(
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        DateKey,
        SalesAmount AS sales_amount,
        ReturnAmount AS return_amount,
        DiscountAmount AS discount_amount,
        TotalCost AS total_cost
    FROM retail.FactSales

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        DateKey,
        SalesAmount AS sales_amount,
        ReturnAmount AS return_amount,
        DiscountAmount AS discount_amount,
        TotalCost AS total_cost
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
) AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE f.DateKey >= last_quarter_start
  AND f.DateKey < current_quarter_start
GROUP BY brand_name
ORDER BY profit DESC, brand_name ASC
